One record per renovation job on pre-1978 housing. The checklist below is the EPA RRP record package.

Certification expiry

Firm certification and each certified renovator expire every 5 years. A lapsed cert means work stops.

Everything is stored in this browser. Download a backup before switching devices, and keep copies for the EPA's 3-year retention rule.

blog.title: LeadFile: the lead-safe paperwork your jobs already need
blog.description: A simple job-by-job record keeper for the EPA's lead paint renovation rule — pamphlet delivery, test results, certified renovator, cleaning verification, and a printable compliance package.

body.text: If you paint, remodel, or do any renovation work on homes built before 1978, the EPA's Renovation, Repair, and Painting rule applies to you. And enforcement is almost entirely about paperwork: firms have paid $10,000 to $22,500 per case, mostly for recordkeeping violations — not for how they did the work. The rule requires a record package for every covered job, kept for three years.
The records are the whole game

For each job, the EPA wants proof of five things: the Renovate Right pamphlet went to the occupant, the lead test result (or a formal assumption of lead paint), a certified renovator assigned to the job, lead-safe training for the crew, and cleaning verification after the work. Miss any one of those records and the job is out of compliance — even if the work itself was perfect.

items: A job register with year built, start date, and a test-or-assume-lead path for every job
The five required records as a per-job checklist with dates, methods, and details
Firm and renovator certification expiry countdowns — a lapsed cert means work stops
A printable compliance package per job with signature lines, ready for your files
Local storage with one-click JSON backup for the 3-year retention rule

body.text: No logins, no integrations, no annual contract. It runs entirely in your browser, so there is nothing to install and no data leaving your machine. One avoided fine pays for decades of it.
